name: Efficient Ingestion
description: System-level plugin that owns the chunk-reuse re-embed engine on embedder changes: stored sources of every agent are re-embedded reusing the stored chunks (fallback to full re-ingest) and image points are recovered via embed_images when multimodal. Settings live in the global system:agent store under the 're-ingestion' category.
tags: core, default, ingestion, re-embed, re-ingestion, embedder
